title: The Confidence Trap: Gender Bias and Predictive Certainty in LLMs
reasoning: The paper's primary contribution is a 'fairness-aware evaluation of LLMs' confidence calibration' and it introduces a new metric, Gender-ECE, to measure gender disparities. This constitutes a direct evaluation and benchmarking of an ethical aspect (fairness) of LLMs, which is central to the paper's methodology and not just a cursory mention.
